title: Finding
description: A specific instance of a Signal firing against a specific Officeholder.

producing_filings.description: The filing whose rows produced this Finding, as a one-item list. A Finding is one report on which a signal fired, which is what the glossary on every page tells a reader it is, and thirteen places in this repository read producing_filings[0] as though the list held one. The schema permitted many, so those thirteen were correct by luck: a Finding over two reports would have had the second silently ignored on every surface, and the reader would have met a Finding whose own evidence was half missing. maxItems keeps the shape the code assumes and the shape the reader is promised as one shape. A Signal that needs a Finding over several reports is a design change, and it should be made to confront those thirteen readers rather than pass them (the Council's second reading of the built answer, Seat C).

fired_at.description: The built_at of the build in which this Finding first appeared: the retrieval time of the latest source capture that build read, never the clock, so the same inputs produce the same row.

build_hash.description: SHA-256, by the seal's own rule (tools/verify.py), over the rows the Signal read at the build that first produced this Finding. It is not the build's seal: a row cannot carry the digest of a seal that covers it.

description.description: Description text derived from the Signal's template. No verdict language.

superseded_by.description: Finding ID that supersedes this one, when a later build corrects it.

frame.const: Presence in the register is not evidence of wrongdoing.
frame.description: The frame, on the row itself, so a Finding lifted whole from the ledger carries it wherever it goes (CHARTER Vow II; METHODOLOGY 4.4).

correction.description: Present only on a row that corrects an earlier one: source when the record the Finding read has changed, register when the register erred in reading it. Written by the runner (src/signals/run.py --correct), never typed, and shown on the page beside the reason.

notes.description: Null on a Finding as a Signal produces it. On a correction, the reason, as the person correcting wrote it, citing the source that shows it.

evidence.description: What the record shows and what the Signal computed from it, in the Signal's own terms, so a reader holding only this row can check the Finding against the filing without running any code. Its shape is set by the Signal's definition; it carries no verdict.
